entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Shri Rakesh Dwivedi - Advocate for the petitioners.

Shri Alok Agnihotri - Government Advocate for the res
 Order

Petitioners have approached this Court seeking direction to the respondent No.3 - Land Acquisition Officer cum Sub-Divisional-Officer (Revenue), Tahsil- Chitrangi, District- Singrauli to decide the objections filed by the petitioners in respect of the proposed acquisition of land before passing the final award.

Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that a notification was issued for acquisition of additional land for the purpose of laying down the Lalitpur-Singrauli Railway Line and the petitioner's land is proposed for acquisition.

The petitioners filed objections to the notification issued under Section 11 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 but the objections have not been decided till now.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
Learned counsel for the petitioners further submits that if a direction is NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-JBP:410 2 WP-41466-2024 issued to Land Acquisition Officer to decide the objections submitted by the petitioners, the petitioners will be satisfied.

Considering the fact that petitioners have already filed the objections before the Land Acquisition Officer, the present petition is disposed of with a direction to respondent No.3 - Land Acquisition Officer to decide the objections submitted by the petitioners, in accordance with the provisions of Section 19 of the Act, 2013.
With the aforesaid, present petition is disposed of.
